about: Shared vectors for the personal-data check. The API (app/ai/personal_data.py) and the web app's copy both read this file, so the two cannot drift. 'caught' texts must be flagged, 'passes' texts must not. Every number here is made up. Both copies normalize the text first, in this order, and then match ASCII digits only ([0-9], never a Unicode-aware digit class): (1) Unicode NFKC normalization; (2) drop every character in category Cf (format characters such as the zero-width space and joiners); (3) map every character in category Zs (space separators such as the no-break space and the thin space) to an ASCII space; (4) map every character in category Pd (dashes such as the non-breaking hyphen, en dash, and minus-like dashes) to an ASCII hyphen-minus. Full-width digits become ASCII digits in step 1.
